shared/scripts/build/browser-loader.js

Runtime bundle dispatcher, inlined into dist/index.html by
Source src/shared/scripts/build/browser-loader.js
UX surface The repo verbs — build, verify, test, docs, i18n, media, setup, scaffold.

Members

probe

Evaluates a feature probe; a thrown parse/runtime error = unsupported.

supportsModule

Native ES module support (IE/EdgeHTML and pre-Chrome-61 lack it).

supportsImport

Dynamic import() — Safari ≤11.0 / Edge ≤18 have modules but no import(). Compile-only probe: executing the import could hit CSP script-src, so we only check that the syntax parses.

detectBrowser

UA identification — the manifest's browsers list is ordered most-specific-first (Samsung Internet / Edge / Opera all claim Chrome; every modern UA claims Safari). Result is exposed to the app as window.__LK_BROWSER and to stylesheets as data-browser / data-browser-major on so engine quirks never get re-sniffed.

applyBrowserHints

Applies the detected engine's quirks: datasets for CSS hooks plus the __LK_BROWSER hint bag the runtime consults (webgpu:false skips a doomed WebGPU init, lowGpu lets renderers start at reduced scale).

pickTier

Picks the newest tier whose probes all pass.

neededPolyfills

Collects polyfills whose guard APIs are missing, in declared order.

loadScript

Injects a classic script; calls back when it has executed.

loadPolyfills

Chains polyfill scripts so each executes before the next is fetched.

injectCss

Appends the tier stylesheet to .

showFallback

Graceful notice for engines below every tier (e.g. IE11).

boot

Boots the selected tier after its polyfills have executed.
